title: A clearer view of your launch
summary: An illustrative launch scenario. Explore the monthly trend, compare plans, and adjust the assumptions to see how revenue changes.

blocks.title: Explore the monthly revenue
blocks.note: Customers × monthly price. Annualized revenue assumes the same customer count for 12 months; it is not a forecast.

items.title: Start with your assumptions
items.text: Set a customer count and monthly price that match your own evidence.

items.title: Compare the growth paths
items.text: Inspect each month and toggle a series to focus on one scenario. These values are illustrative.

items.title: Review the limitations
items.text: Revenue is not profit. Account for churn, taxes, and operating costs before making a decision.
